It still is a external function too cause I don't wanna pollute the hook itself

Okay so basically with `InstantSearchSSRProvider`, in Strict Mode it creates two instances of InstantSearch and starts both without disposing the first. Even with a `useEffect` cleanup it doesn't work as we start during render instead of inside an effect.
We do have to start at first render else there's a hydration mismatch.

I spent quite a lot of time looking for a solution within this file but it doesn't seem possible so I added a `useRef` in the provider which we use instead.
The only drawback I can think of is it's no longer possible to have two instances of `InstantSearch` within the same `InstantSearchSSRProvider` context which I guess wouldn't make sense anyway
